detailed_descriptions.en: Track and hunt bunnies in the woods with your bow. It’s what the King demands. Load the catapult and hurl them into the castle. No one will thank you. Things tend to get stranger… and far more dangerous. Do you think you can satisfy the King's desires? He’s not known for his mercy. IN BUNNY HURLING, YOU CAN... Move stealthily and wait for the perfect moment to shoot your arrow! Lure the bunnies with a bunny caller ! Beware of vengeful creatures and ghosts ! You're not the only predator in the forest! Freely explore a vast non-linear map , full of bunny curiosities and much more!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Track and hunt bunnies in the woods with your bow. It’s what the King demands.

Load the catapult and hurl them into the castle. No one will thank you.

Things tend to get stranger… and far more dangerous.

Do you think you can satisfy the King's desires? He’s not known for his mercy.

IN BUNNY HURLING, YOU CAN...

  • Move stealthily and wait for the perfect moment to shoot your arrow!

  • Lure the bunnies with a bunny caller!

  • Beware of vengeful creatures and ghosts! You're not the only predator in the forest!

  • Freely explore a vast non-linear map, full of bunny curiosities and much more!
